# Graphlet-edge recovery vs Stage3 recall (standard VQ arms)

48 standard 3x(256,32) VQ arms; q rebuilt from codebooks + exported SID tokens; global k=10 q-kNN graph. Triangle/K4/inside/cross are exact edge sets. K1,4 / P5 / T5 / C5 use the existing **strict sampled 5-node instances** (300 each); edges are deduplicated.

Behaviour graph: **24587** nodes, **315391** edges; inside **188588**, cross **126803**.

## Recovery rates and correlations

`partial` controls overall recovery, q-kNN edge count and L3 collision. `excess` subtracts the arm's degree-bin expected recovery for the same edge set; the degree-adjusted correlation uses that excess.
